newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA-UTENA JUST TOPS BREWERS IN FIRST HALF.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-UTENA JUST TOPS BREWERS IN FIRST HALF.

text.p: Utena Beverages barely edged out Kalnapilis for the top spot among Lithuanian beer brewers in production and sales in the first half of 1997, the breweries association said on Friday.
But Kalnapilis out-brewed and out-sold its rival in June.
Utena brewed 1.506 million decalitres of beer in the first six months of this year, compared to Kalnapilis 1.425 million decalitres.
Utena sold 1.494 million decalitres in the first of the year compared to Kalnapilis 1.382 million decalitres.
Shvyturys came in third in production and sales, brewing 1.250 million decalitres and selling 1.248 million decalitres.
In the first six months of 1996, Utena brewed 1.853 million decalitres, Kalnapilis 1.027 million decalitres and Shvyturys 858,000 decalitres.
Utena produced 293,000 decalitres and sold 291,000 decalitres of beer in June. Utena's production and sales both increased by seven percent from May to June.
Kalnapilis out-brewed and out-sold Utena in June, when its production jumped 25 percent to 348,000 decalitres and sales leaped 31 percent to 355,000 decalitres.
Shvyturys' production rose by six percent in June to 310,000 decalitres and sales advanced 11 percent to 316,000 decalitres.
